topic: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas
outcome: Describe how sounds and short musical ideas can represent experiences, moods, images or storylines.

topic: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas
outcome: Describe and show how sounds and musical ideas can represent sonic events, memories, concepts, texts or storylines.

topic: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas
outcome: Describe and show several ways sounds and musical ideas can represent extended sonic experiences or abstract ideas.

topic: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas
outcome: Assemble and organize sounds or short musical ideas into first expressions of chosen experiences, moods or storylines.

topic: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas
outcome: Assemble and organize several sounds or ideas into first expressive statements of chosen events, memories, concepts or texts.

topic: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas
outcome: Assemble and organize sounds or extended ideas into first expressive statements of extended experiences or abstract ideas.

topic: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas
outcome: Identify and describe how sounds and short ideas develop in drafts using simple forms like one-part, cyclical or binary.

topic: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas
outcome: Describe and explain how ideas develop in drafts in simple or moderately complex forms like binary, rondo or ternary.

topic: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas
outcome: Analyze and show how sounds and extended ideas develop in drafts in moderately complex or complex forms.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Use teacher-provided criteria to assess and refine the technical and expressive sides of drafts.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Use teacher-provided or personal criteria to assess and refine the technical and expressive sides of drafts.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Research, explain and apply personal criteria to assess and refine the technical and expressive sides of drafts.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Share music through notation, performance or technology and show how elements of music express intent.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Share music through notation, performance or technology and describe how elements and compositional techniques express intent.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Share music through notation, performance or technology and explain how elements, techniques and processes express intent.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Describe the given context and performance medium for presenting personal works and how they affect the final piece.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Describe chosen contexts and mediums for presenting personal works and explain why they shape the final piece well.

topic: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work
outcome: Describe many possible contexts and mediums for presenting personal works and compare how each could affect success.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Identify and select passages in musical works in simple forms that express an experience, mood, image or storyline.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Identify and select passages or movements in works in simple or moderately complex forms that express experiences, moods, concepts or texts.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Identify and select sections, movements or whole works in moderately complex or complex forms that express experiences, concepts or texts.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Analyze how the elements of music, including form, relate to style and mood, and explain what this means for rehearsal.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Analyze how the elements of music relate to style, function and context, and explain what this means for rehearsal.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Analyze how elements and compositional techniques relate to style, function and context, and support the analysis for rehearsal and performance.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Develop interpretations from the use of elements, style and mood, explaining how choices reflect the creators' intent.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Develop interpretations from elements, style, mood, function and context, supporting how choices reflect intent.

topic: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation
outcome: Develop interpretations from elements, form, techniques, style, function and context, justifying how choices reflect intent.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Create rehearsal plans identifying repetition and variation within the form.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Create rehearsal plans identifying form, repetition and variation, and the style and context of the work.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Create rehearsal plans identifying form, repetition and variation, compositional techniques, style and context.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Use criteria and feedback to identify how performances convey elements of music, style and mood.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Use criteria and feedback to identify how performances convey formal design, style and context.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Use criteria and feedback to identify how performances use compositional techniques and convey design, style and context.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Identify and use strategies to improve the technical and expressive sides of several works.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Identify and use strategies to improve the technical and expressive sides of varied works.

topic: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation
outcome: Identify, compare and use strategies to improve the technical and expressive sides of contrasting works.

topic: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work
outcome: Share live or recorded performances of works and explain how elements of music convey intent.

topic: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work
outcome: Share performances of works and explain how elements and compositional techniques convey intent.

topic: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work
outcome: Share performances of works and explain or show how the expressive intent is conveyed.

topic: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work
outcome: Identify how compositions suit an audience or context and how this shapes future compositions.

topic: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work
outcome: Explain how compositions suit both audience and context and how this shapes future compositions.

topic: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work
outcome: Explain how compositions suit a variety of audiences and contexts and how this shapes future compositions.

topic: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

topic: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work
outcome: Apply teacher-provided or personal criteria to select music in simple or moderately complex forms, and defend it as a model.

topic: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work
outcome: Apply researched or personal criteria to select music in moderately complex or complex forms, and justify it as a model.

topic: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work
outcome: Analyze by ear the elements of music, relating them to style, mood and context, and describe the analysis as a model for growth.

topic: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work
outcome: Analyze by ear or score the elements and compositional techniques, relating them to style, mood and context, and explain the model for growth.

topic: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work
outcome: Analyze by ear or score the elements and techniques, relating them to aesthetic effectiveness, style, mood and context.

topic: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

topic: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work
outcome: Develop and support interpretations, citing elements, form, techniques, style and context to show composers' intent.

topic: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work
outcome: Develop, justify and defend interpretations, citing elements, form, techniques, style and context to show composers' intent.

topic: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

topic: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work
outcome: Explain the effectiveness of technical and expressive aspects using music theory and compositional techniques.

topic: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work
outcome: Evaluate the effectiveness of technical and expressive aspects using theoretical concepts and complex techniques.

topic: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work
outcome: Describe how critiquing others' work and getting feedback can be used in your own creative process.

topic: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work
outcome: Describe how critiquing others and receiving feedback have been applied in your own creative process.

topic: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work
outcome: Describe and evaluate how critiquing others and receiving feedback have been applied in your creative process.
